name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Sour Watermelon Apple
description: Enjoy sweet n’ sour with Double-Stacked Sour Watermelon Apple BITEZ. Two bold layers pair juicy watermelon sweetness with tart green apple sourness for a mouthwatering sweet-and-sour combo that keeps every bite bright and tangy. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). High potency meets serious pucker in every bite.
